gen.title: How Air Properties Change Above the Surface

cards.stem: Which phrase describes the air that reaches to the edge of space
cards.quote: The Earth’s atmosphere is an extremely thin sheet of air extending from the surface of the Earth to the edge of space
cards.hint: Think about how thin the layer is compared to the planet

cards.stem: What is said to extend upward from the surface
cards.quote: Variations in air properties extend upward from the surface of the Earth.
cards.hint: Focus on what changes with height

cards.stem: How is the air temperature described near the ground compared to higher up
cards.quote: Thus the air temperature is highest near the surface and decreases as altitude increases.

cards.stem: What happens to air pressure when altitude increases
cards.quote: Therefore, air pressure decreases as we increase altitude.
cards.hint: Think about how much air is above you as you go up
